name: Documents
description: Document conversion bits: markdown to HTML or plain text, and text or markdown to a real PDF.

operations.name: docs.markdownHtml
operations.description: Converts markdown to an HTML string. Returns {html}.
operations.howto: Feed "markdown" from a textarea or from file.read's base64 output decoded upstream; route "html" into state for display or for file.save.

operations.name: docs.markdownText
operations.description: Flattens markdown to readable plain text (headings and list markers kept). Returns {text}.
operations.howto: Route "text" into state to preview a document without markup.

operations.name: docs.textPdf
operations.description: Builds a real PDF from plain text (each line one PDF line, wrapped, paginated). Returns {base64, pages}; feed base64 to file.save.

inputs.name: title
inputs.description: Document title on the first page

outputs.name: file
outputs.description: The produced PDF; give it to file.save and bind the pdf viewer from its url

outputs.name: url
outputs.description: Bind a pdf element's src to this

operations.howto: For markdown sources use docs.markdownPdf instead. Route "base64" into state and chain file.save with a name ending in .pdf. Suggest a name ending in .pdf to file.save (a constant like "document.pdf"), never the source file's own name. Prefer the file output over base64: bind file.save's "file" input and the pdf element's src from "url".

operations.name: docs.markdownPdf
operations.description: Builds a real PDF from markdown (headings sized, lists kept, wrapped, paginated). Returns {base64, pages}; feed base64 to file.save.

inputs.name: markdown
inputs.description: Markdown source text (file.read's "text" output for a picked .md file)

inputs.name: title
inputs.description: Document title on the first page

outputs.name: file
outputs.description: The produced PDF; give it to file.save and bind the pdf viewer from its url

outputs.name: url
outputs.description: Bind a pdf element's src to this

operations.howto: The converter chain on one click: file.pick (markdown) routes "file" to state, file.read routes "text" to state, docs.markdownPdf binds "markdown" from that key and routes "base64" to state, file.save takes it with a name like "notes.pdf". Show "pages" in a caption. Suggest a name ending in .pdf to file.save (a constant like "document.pdf"), never the source file's own name. Prefer the file output over base64: bind file.save's "file" input and the pdf element's src from "url".

operations.name: docs.docxText
operations.description: Extracts the text of a Word document (.docx): paragraphs become lines. Returns {text, length}.

inputs.name: file
inputs.description: A picked .docx (file.pick's file output); preferred over base64

inputs.name: base64
inputs.description: Legacy alternative to "file": base64 from file.read

operations.howto: The office converter chain: file.pick -> file.read -> docs.docxText routes "text" into state for display, for docs.textPdf (a docx to PDF converter), or for file.save as .txt.
